sentence: New employees will ___ a two-day orientation program.
explanation: 'Undergo' means to experience a process, such as training.

sentence: Ms. Novak was ___ to the position of regional manager.
explanation: 'Was promoted to' means moved to a higher position.

sentence: Staff members are ___ to submit vacation requests two weeks in advance.
explanation: 'Are encouraged to' is the passive structure.

sentence: The company provides ___ opportunities for professional growth.
explanation: 'Numerous opportunities' means many opportunities.

sentence: To be ___ for the position, applicants must have a college degree.
explanation: 'Eligible for' means qualified to be considered.

sentence: The interview panel will ___ each candidate's qualifications carefully.
explanation: 'Assess' means to evaluate.

sentence: Mr. Ahmed will ___ as team leader while Ms. Brooks is on leave.
explanation: 'Will serve as' needs the base form.

sentence: Employees must ___ their time sheets by the end of each week.
explanation: 'Submit a time sheet' means hand it in.

sentence: The company offers a generous retirement ___ to all full-time workers.
explanation: 'Retirement package' is a standard noun phrase.

sentence: A ___ of the new staff handbook will be distributed on Monday.
explanation: 'A copy of' is the standard phrase.

sentence: Ms. Sharma has been a loyal ___ of the firm for twenty years.
explanation: An 'employee' is the person who works for the firm.

sentence: The firm is seeking a ___ assistant with strong organizational skills.
explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'assistant'.

sentence: The personnel office will ___ the new employees' health insurance forms.
explanation: 'Process forms' means to handle them administratively.

sentence: Staff are reminded that the ___ for annual leave requests is May 1.
explanation: A 'deadline' is the last date for something.

sentence: Our team leader will ___ responsibility for the new training project.
explanation: 'Assume responsibility' means to take it on.

sentence: Mr. Costa was ___ from the sales team to the marketing department.
explanation: 'Transferred from ... to' means moved.

sentence: The workshop is designed to improve employees' communication ___.
explanation: 'Communication skills' is a standard noun phrase.

sentence: The manager gave a ___ review of each employee's performance.
explanation: 'Thorough review' means complete and careful.

sentence: All overtime hours must be ___ by a supervisor.
explanation: 'Be approved by' is the passive structure.

sentence: Newly hired staff are ___ to attend all orientation sessions.
explanation: 'Are expected to' is the passive structure.

sentence: The company has a strict ___ against discrimination in the workplace.
explanation: A 'policy' is a formal rule of an organization.

sentence: We are looking for someone ___ in managing a large team.
explanation: 'Someone experienced in' uses a past participle adjective.

sentence: Ms. Valdez is highly ___ by her colleagues for her honesty.
explanation: 'Is respected by' is the passive structure.

sentence: The training will be ___ by an expert from the head office.
explanation: 'Be conducted by' means to be carried out by.

sentence: Employees receive a ___ evaluation once a year.
explanation: 'Performance evaluation' is the standard noun phrase.

sentence: Because of her ___ in the field, Ms. Ito was invited to give a lecture.
explanation: 'Her expertise' means her specialized knowledge.

sentence: The department head asked for volunteers to ___ the new intern.
explanation: 'Mentor' means to guide and advise.

sentence: Applicants are ___ to provide at least two references.
explanation: 'Are required to' is the passive structure.

sentence: The new manager's ___ approach has improved team spirit.
explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'approach'.

sentence: Mr. Lee left the company to ___ a career in teaching.
explanation: 'Pursue a career' is a fixed collocation.

sentence: Please ___ me of any changes to your contact information.
explanation: 'Notify someone of' means to inform them.

sentence: Interns will work ___ the supervision of experienced staff.
explanation: 'Under the supervision of' is a fixed expression.

sentence: The company has ___ a new policy on remote work.
explanation: 'Adopted a policy' means formally accepted and began using it.

sentence: Ms. Fischer's ___ to the team has been invaluable.
explanation: After the possessive, a noun is needed: 'contribution to'.

sentence: Managers must ensure that all staff ___ the new safety guidelines.
explanation: After 'ensure that all staff', a plural present verb is needed.

sentence: Staff who work on public holidays are ___ for the extra hours.
explanation: 'Are compensated for' is the passive structure.

sentence: The training budget has been ___ to include online courses.
explanation: 'Expanded to include' means extended to cover.

sentence: Please ___ your supervisor if you will be absent from work.
explanation: After 'Please', the base verb 'inform' is needed.

sentence: The employee handbook ___ the company's policies on leave and benefits.
explanation: 'Outlines' means describes the main points of.
